response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with a strong web/backend background (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) and some historical C/C++ work at National Instruments, but the profile does not match this role's core requirements. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese (languages listed are English, Romanian, basic German), no Linux kernel analysis or source modification experience, and no demonstrated background in embedded LAN-switch firmware, L2/L3 networking, MACsec/802.1X, or chip-vendor SDKs. C for UNIX development appears only briefly a decade ago. The gap on hard requirements is too wide to justify an interview.
strengths: Deep, varied senior-level engineering experience across many stacks
Some C/C++ and Linux systems exposure (NI LabWindows/CVI, audio server project)
Strong testing, TDD, CI/CD and developer-tooling discipline
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed (hard requirement)
No Linux kernel or embedded networking/security experience
Primary C experience is minimal and over a decade old

key_factors.factor: No embedded/networking security or kernel work
